disable_root.description: If true, disables SSH login for the root user.

ssh_pwauth.description: If true, enables password authentication for SSH.

preserve_hostname.description: If true, prevents cloud-init from changing the hostname.

ssh_deletekeys.description: If true, deletes SSH host keys on first boot.

ssh_genkeytypes.description: List of SSH key types to generate on first boot.

default_user_lock_passwd.description: If true, locks the password for the default user.

default_user_gecos.description: The GECOS field for the default user.

default_user_groups.description: List of groups the default user belongs to.

default_user_sudo.description: Sudo configuration for the default user.

default_user_shell.description: The shell for the default user.

network_renderers.description: List of network renderers to use.

cloud_dir.description: The directory where cloud-init stores state.

ssh_svcname.description: The name of the SSH service.
